en.headline: FEHD prosecutes Telford Plaza restaurant after rodent complaint
en.dek: Inspectors found poor hygiene at the Kowloon Bay restaurant and issued a rodent notice, as a two-week food-premises sweep begins.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it had prosecuted the operator of a restaurant at Telford Plaza in Kowloon Bay after a rodent complaint, following an inspection on Thursday that found hygiene at the premises unsatisfactory.

The department said officers had checked environmental hygiene, rodent-proofing, and how food was stored and handled. It prosecuted the operator under the Food Business Regulation and issued a notice requiring the elimination of rodents. The operator was told to take immediate remedial steps on rodent control, food safety and environmental hygiene. The department said it would follow up and step up revisits or further enforcement if needed.

Footage circulating online on Thursday showed a rodent at a Cafe de Coral outlet in the mall. The department did not name the restaurant in its account. It said online footage could be used as an investigative lead, but a prosecution depended on the evidence as a whole, including the inspection and information from the complainant. Food that had been or was reasonably suspected to have been contaminated by rodents should not be supplied or sold, it said.
In light of recent cases, the department said it had started a two-week Sky Net operation, with more inspections of supermarkets, restaurants and other premises that sell, store or handle food.

zh.headline: 食環署巡查德福廣場食肆後提出檢控
zh.dek: 署方指九龍灣該食肆衛生欠佳，已發消除蟲鼠通知，並展開為期兩星期的天羅行動。
body: 食物環境衞生署表示，因應一宗涉及九龍灣德福廣場食肆的鼠患投訴，周四再次派員巡查，發現該食肆衞生情況欠佳，已向負責人提出檢控。
署方說，人員重點檢查處所環境衞生、防鼠措施，以及食物貯存和處理情況。署方根據《食物業規例》向負責人提出檢控，並發出《消除蟲鼠通知》，要求即時採取補救措施，加強防鼠、食物安全及環境衞生管理。署方會按現場發現繼續跟進，有需要時加密覆查或採取進一步執法行動。
周四網上流傳影片，顯示德福廣場一間大家樂有老鼠出沒。署方的交代沒有點名食肆。署方說，網上影片可作調查線索，但會否檢控須視乎整體證據，包括現場巡查結果及投訴人資料。任何已受到或合理懷疑受到鼠隻污染的食品，不應繼續供應或出售。
署方又指，因應近日相關個案，已展開為期兩星期的「天羅行動」，針對超級市場、食肆及其他涉及食物售賣、貯存或處理的處所加強巡查。
